main.description: A reaction to a message. Written to the reacting user's repo; removing the reaction deletes the record.

target.description: The reacted-to message: the record key of a `space.roomy.room.message` record.

user.description: The reacting user. For a bridged reaction this is the reacting user the bridge names, not the account that relayed it.

reaction.description: The emoji, or a URI describing one.

bridged.description: Set when the reaction arrived through a bridge, whose user may be an external account.
